messages.subject: Re: SSL support
messages.body_plain:
Supposedly this has been resolved, 
see: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/28482913/connect-to-redshift-via-ssl-using-r

However is any of this documented anywhere?  I can not get this to work 
though I can connect happily via the command line using psql

Additionally, not strictly an issues with RPostgreSQL, the sslrootcert 
option mentioned in the answer linked to above only takes the name of the 
certificate file, i.e. not the path to the file.  The expected location of 
certificate files is documented here: 
http://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/static/libpq-ssl.html

On Wednesday, 9 October 2013 20:25:55 UTC+1, Hadley Wickham wrote:
>
> Hi all,
>
> Is SSL support on the roadmap for RPostgreSQL? It seems to be a 
> requirement for connecting to most hosted db services.
>
> Thanks!
>
> Hadley
>

--
